author: Karl Rock
description:
The first time I visited Karachi, I honestly had a terrible experience. I struggled to enjoy the city and left wondering what all the fuss was about. But I decided it deserved a second chance, so I returned with an open mind. And what a difference a second visit made! This time around, I discovered a completely different side of Karachi, met some wonderful people, experienced its incredible food and culture, and found myself enjoying the city far more than I ever expected.

Turns out, Karachi and I just needed a second date!
title: I Hated Karachi!
